evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by trust, governance, compliance, data quality, and 'single source of truth' language throughout, with no velocity/speed framing present.
evidence.domain_risk: Own KPI definitions and business rules, collaborate with Data Governance to ensure data quality and compliance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect executive strategy and business performance decisions for a telecom operator, with governance and compliance named explicitly, but no financial-reporting or regulatory-specific language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Engineering; Data Governance; business stakeholders

evidence.jd_authorship: Own KPI definitions and business rules, collaborate with Data Governance to ensure data quality and compliance, contribute to metadata and data lineage initiatives

evidence.stakeholder_orientation: you'll be the mastermind behind creating trusted, reusable, and analytics-ready data products that drive smarter decisions across the consumer business unit
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's core mission is the data platform/product itself (KPIs, semantic layer, data governance, self-service analytics) serving the wider business, placing it as internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own KPI definitions and business rules... Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, support analysts with reliable data assets

evidence.ai_role: Prepare data for AI-driven analytics and natural language access, develop trusted datasets, evaluate new technologies to enhance user experience, and support the shift toward augmented analytics
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build data infrastructure that AI/LLM systems consume — 'prepare data for AI-driven analytics and natural language access' and 'LLM-based querying, conversational analytics, AI copilots' — the AI is downstream of the candidate's data output.
evidence.testing_framing: collaborate with Data Governance to ensure data quality and compliance... experience with data governance tools (e.g., DataGalaxy)... and data quality management
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is framed as an owned responsibility ('ensure data quality and compliance') with a named governance tool, not just a passing skill mention.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Without your expertise, teams would still be stuck with fragmented KPIs, manual reports, and inconsistent data — holding back growth, trust, and the future of AI-driven innovation
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD repeatedly frames the role around preventing untrustworthy data ('trusted', 'single source of truth', 'clear, trustworthy, and scalable') appearing prominently in the role summary itself, indicating a high risk register centered on data trust.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: enhance the analytics stack and semantic layer, and improve scalability, performance, and maintainability of solutions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds new data products/KPIs and enhances/improves an existing analytics stack and semantic layer, a genuine mix.
evidence.language_gate: Fluent in English (knowledge of French is also desirable)
